principal.heading: {yearsInWords} years of curious minds
paragraphs: Welcome to Busarialao College. Since {foundedYear} we have believed that every child can think like a scientist: ask good questions, test ideas and learn from mistakes. Our laboratories, small classes and caring staff give students room to grow in knowledge and in character.

From JSS1 to SS3, we prepare them for BECE, WASSCE and NECO, and for the choices that follow. As we mark our 20th anniversary, we remain committed to discipline, integrity and excellence, and to partnering with parents at every step.
Whether your child joins us as a day student or a boarder, they will find a community that expects their best and supports them to give it. We would be glad to welcome you on a visit.
